scope: All archived study gene IDs; exact human Ensembl matches from reviewed UniProt entries and the human reference proteome UP000005640. Other proteomes and isoforms are not exhaustive.

structureScope: One reviewed protein accession per archived OXPHOS gene where available; first downloadable PDB reference among the first three and one exact-sequence human AlphaFold prediction. Compact viewer limit 10 MB per model. This is a representative library, not all known structures or proof of the expressed isoform.
